prompt:

Header text verbatim: "ett fartyg". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "ship".
Scene: A large unbranded cargo ship leaving a harbour through open water, hull and superstructure coherent, no readable ship name.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "fartyg = ship; a large vessel.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Fartyget lämnar hamnen.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
